sara (PM): Quick sync: two inbound pilots want concrete retention + BYOK terms before contract sign. Need minimal product commitments to include in SOW by Friday.
aj (Eng): Understood. Do we want fixed tiers or a customizable SOW per customer?
mohit (Security): Minimum productized set + premium custom tier. Productized tiers reduce risk and cert burden.
claire (Legal): Agreed on product tiers. For custom SOWs we need templated clauses for key escrow, export windows, and legal hold.
sara (PM): Draft product tiers idea: 
```
- Bronze (self-serve): metadata 1y, payload 30d, no BYOK
- Silver (contract): metadata 3y, payload 1y, BYOK read-only export support, 72h evidence export
- Gold (enterprise): metadata 7y, payload archived up to 7y, BYOK (HSM), accelerated export 48h, regional keys
```
tim (Infra): Important: "archived up to 7y" needs cold-storage + index. Retrieval timeline depends on archive class. 48h is plausible if we pre-warm retrieval path. Cost delta significant.
aj (Eng): Technical constraints - BYOK + encrypted payloads: if keys never shared, we can't decrypt for export. We need a clear export token flow or escrow option.
mohit (Security): Escrow options: (A) customer escrow with notarized handoff (B) customer grants limited-decrypt key via KMS cross-account token (C) Redwood holds transient escrow with strict access controls & audit. (C) raises compliance/legal questions.
claire (Legal): We can accept (B) in many cases. (C) may be needed for law enforcement requests but needs explicit contract acceptance and indemnities.
sara (PM): Let's include all three options in the scoping doc and mark which require legal approval.
ops-bot: New draft created: https://docs.redwood/internal/retention-byok-playbook (view: product,security,legal)
aj (Eng): Suggest we add: integrity proofs (hash chain) + archival manifest per export so the evidence is verifiable.
mohit (Security): Also: KMS ops must be logged to immutable control plane logs (separate export stream). Required for SOC2/ISO.
tim (Infra): Cost estimate note: Bronze baseline low-cost. Silver adds index replication and 2x cold retrieval. Gold needs regional HSM and pre-warm windows - will cost x3+. I'll model this.
sara (PM): Action list:
- tim & aj: rough cost model + retrieval engineering approach (due Wed 10am)
- mohit: BYOK escrow modes + SOC2 control checklist mapping (due Wed EOD)
- claire: draft SOW clauses for each tier + legal hold wording (due Thu)
- sara: consolidate and prep SOW snippets for sales (due Fri morning)
ajn(typo): FYI - ACME prototype asked about immutable chain for export; they want attestation cert.
claire (Legal): We'll add attestation language. If customer requires 10y retention, route to Gold + paid add-on.
sara (PM): If there are urgent customer constraints, ping me directly. Will share compiled doc Thu AM. Thanks. :raised_hands:
